rows.text: with W = word `02064B0C`: stores `0x3F000000` to dword `02064B04`, W+1 to word `02064DC8`, W+`0xE0` to word `02064DD8` and float `02064CB0` minus float `02064CB4` to `02064B10`, and returns when word `02064DD0` is W+1; else ANDs `02064DD8` with word `02064B10` and sets `02064DC8` to W+`0x118`; if `02064DD8` is now W and word `02064DD4` is not, it returns, first adding word `02064DCC` minus 1 to `02064DC8` unless `02064DCC` is W; if both are W, it stores `02064CB0`/`02064CB4` (`0x7F7FFFFF` if zero) to `02064B00`, subtracts the truncated quotient times `02064CB4` from `02064CB0` (the product to `02064CC0`) and calls the site `004B0F60` + 0x103; then, on that path or when `02064DD8` is not W: if `02064DCC` is not W, it truncates `02064CB0` to an integer in place and, from index `02064DC8`, subtracts the word `+0` of each 16-byte record at `02064E34` (each to `02064DD0`) until the 16-bit remainder is negative, storing the last index to `02064DC8` and the remainder to `02064DD4`; if it is W, it stores `02064CB0`/float `02064CB8` (`0x7F7FFFFF` for zero) to `02064B00` and `02064CB4`, calls the site + 0x1F1 when that is 0 and + 0x203 when negative, and truncates `02064CB4` in place

returns 1.0 (`01CEBBA8`) in `xmm0` when dword `02064AFC` is 0; otherwise replaces dword `01E02828` with `((v AND 0x3FFFFF) OR 0x1FC00000) * 2` OR bit 0 of `((v >> 18) XOR v) >> 4` (v its old value) and returns the new value as a float in `xmm0`
stores the sums of the three floats at `rdx+0`, `+4`, `+8` and the three at `r8+0`, `+4`, `+8` to the floats at `rcx+0`, `+4`, `+8`
stores `xmm1` divided by `xmm2` to the float at `rcx`, except that when `xmm2` compares equal to 0.0 it stores the float `0x7F7FFFFF` (`00900360`) instead
multiplies each of the three floats at `rdx+0`, `+4`, `+8` by 16.0 (`01CEBC84`), truncates them to integers and stores them to the dwords at `rcx+0`, `+4`, `+8`
copies the word at `02064E34` plus `edx * 16` (the 32-bit product sign-extended) to the word at `rcx`
copies the dword at `02064E34` plus `edx * 16` (the 32-bit product sign-extended) to the dword at `rcx+4`
copies the qword at `02064E38` plus `edx * 16` (the 32-bit product sign-extended) to the qword at `rcx+8`
adds the float at `rdx+0xC` times the float at `r8+4` to the float at `rcx+0xC`
adds each of the four floats at `rdx+0` to `+0xC` times the float at `r8+4` to the float at the same offset of `rcx`
adds each of the four floats at `rdx+0` to `+0xC` times the float at `r8+8` to the float at the same offset of `rcx`
stores each of the four floats at `rdx+0` to `+0xC` times the float at `r8+0xC`, plus the matching float at `02064B20`, `02064B24`, `02064B28` or `02064B2C`, to the float at the same offset of `rcx`
stores the element-wise products of the three floats at `rdx+0`, `+4`, `+8` and the three at `r8+0`, `+4`, `+8` to the floats at `rcx+0`, `+4`, `+8`
stores each of the four floats at `rdx+0` to `+0xC` times the float at `r8` to the float at the same offset of `rcx`
stores `xmm2` times each of the three floats at `rdx+0`, `+4`, `+8` to the floats at `rcx+0`, `+4`, `+8`
stores each of the three floats at `rdx+0`, `+4`, `+8` times the float at `r8+0xC` to the floats at `rcx+0`, `+4`, `+8`
stores each of the three floats at `rdx+0`, `+4`, `+8` times the float at `r8+4` to the floats at `rcx+0`, `+4`, `+8`

stores 1.0 (`01CEBBA8`) to the float at `rcx` when dword `02064AFC` is 0; otherwise replaces dword `01E02828` with `((v AND 0x3FFFFF) OR 0x1FC00000) * 2` OR bit 0 of `((v >> 18) XOR v) >> 4` (v its old value) and stores the new value to the float at `rcx`

stores 1.0 (`01CEBBA8`) to the float at `rcx+4` when dword `02064AFC` is 0; otherwise replaces dword `01E02828` with `((v AND 0x3FFFFF) OR 0x1FC00000) * 2` OR bit 0 of `((v >> 18) XOR v) >> 4` (v its old value) and stores the new value to the float at `rcx+4`

stores 1.0 (`01CEBBA8`) to the float at `rcx+8` when dword `02064AFC` is 0; otherwise replaces dword `01E02828` with `((v AND 0x3FFFFF) OR 0x1FC00000) * 2` OR bit 0 of `((v >> 18) XOR v) >> 4` (v its old value) and stores the new value to the float at `rcx+8`

compares the floats at `rdx+0`, `+4`, `+8` (a0, a1, a2) with those at `r8+0`, `+4`, `+8` (b0, b1, b2) and stores to the word at `rcx` the sum of `0x80` if b0 > a0, `0x40` if b1 > a1, `0x20` if b2 > a2, 8 if a0 = b0, 4 if a1 = b1 and 2 if a2 = b2 (an unordered pair adds nothing)
stores each of the three floats at `rdx+0`, `+4`, `+8` minus `xmm2` to the floats at `rcx+0`, `+4`, `+8`
compares the float at `rdx+4` (a) with the float at `r8+0xC` (b) and stores to the word at `rcx` the sum of `0x40` if b > a and 4 if a = b (an unordered pair stores 0)

notes: 004B0F60 (doubt): the longest row; the paths were traced by hand. Points to re-check: the AND at 004B0FC6 reads the low word of the float just stored to 02064B10 (as the listing shows); 02064CB0 is overwritten with an integer at 004B1096 and its low word seeds the subtraction loop (004B10A4-004B10AA); after the loop the index is decremented once (004B10D3) so 02064DC8 receives the index of the last record subtracted, and 02064DD4 the negative 16-bit remainder; the 0x7F7FFFFF fallback for a zero divisor on the 02064CB8 path comes from xmm6 loaded at 004B0FD3. 0x3F000000 is written to 02064B04 at entry and again at 004B1001 on one path (same value), so the sentence names it once. The call sites + 0x1F1 and + 0x203 are both relative to 004B0F60. 004B97F0, 004B9C50, 004B9CA0, 004B9CF0: the listing decodes 01E02828 as f32 1, which is its initial image value; the sentence names the location, not a value. 004B9D80 and 004B9E60: the weights were derived from the doubling chain (004B9E09-004B9E1F) and the shl by 2 (004B9E8A); NaN handling follows ucomiss/jp and comiss/cmova.
